high_risk_mandatory_review_categories: Identity Attribution (Any assertion linking multiple usernames, hosts, or IPs)
Causal Sufficiency (Any assertion linking event timestamps to causal mechanisms)
Unsupported Fact Assertions (Any natural language text asserting confirmed status)
Citation Boundary Compliance (Any citation to specialist handles vs raw files)
Question Closure Disputes (Any question marked answered without basis)
Material Contradiction Handling (Any conflicting evidence disposition)

anti_leakage_safeguards.execution_freeze_rule: All model outputs across all scheduled seats must be written and cryptographically committed before adjudicators receive review envelopes.
anti_leakage_safeguards.zero_iterative_tuning: Modifying candidate prompt instructions in response to intermediate adjudicator findings is strictly prohibited.
anti_leakage_safeguards.adjudication_auditability: Adjudicator votes (AGREE, DISAGREE, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, REVIEW_ESCALATION_REQUIRED) must be immutably recorded alongside rationale.
